source_name: Oschadbank procurement page (АТ «Ощадбанк», EDRPOU 00032129)
why_relevant: State-owned bank with one of Ukraine's largest ATM and branch networks. Its procurement page and Prozorro buyer profile carry annual procurement plans and tenders for ATM supply/maintenance, cash-packaging and CIT, safes and card services — direct evidence of fleet scale and refresh cycles.

source_name: Ukreximbank procurement page (АТ «Укрексімбанк», EDRPOU 00032112)
why_relevant: State bank publishing general procurement conditions and annual procurement plans; its tenders cover banking IT, cash handling and terminal-related services, giving buyer-side visibility on spend and incumbent suppliers.

source_name: Ukrgasbank tender committee / procurement page (АБ «УКРГАЗБАНК», EDRPOU 23697280)
why_relevant: Third state bank buyer; publishes annual procurement plans. Useful for triangulating state-sector demand for ATMs, self-service kiosks, terminals and processing services and for identifying recurring vendors.

source_name: PrivatBank procurement portal (tender.privatbank.ua / Zakupivli24)
why_relevant: PrivatBank is the largest ATM/POS operator in Ukraine (network reported at roughly 7,000 ATMs and self-service terminals). Its dedicated procurement portal lists purchases for terminal hardware, ATM servicing, cash logistics and processing — the single richest buyer-side pointer in this cell.

source_name: National Bank of Ukraine procurement disclosures (НБУ, EDRPOU 00032106)
why_relevant: The central bank is itself a buyer of cash-processing equipment, banknote handling, security printing inputs and payment-system IT. Its annual plans (including plans for purchases made without Prozorro procedures) and Prozorro buyer profile reveal cash-cycle infrastructure investment invisible in statistics.

source_name: Spending / Є-Data — unified public funds portal (transactions)
why_relevant: Treasury-level transaction and contract-execution data (hundreds of millions of records). Complements Prozorro by showing what was actually paid against contracts for cash handling, terminal servicing and banking IT — useful for validating award values and detecting contract amendments.

source_name: data.gov.ua — public procurement datasets
why_relevant: National open-data portal entry for procurement information published under the Public Procurement Law; provides dataset-level bulk resources and a stable legal basis for reuse.

source_name: TED — Tenders Electronic Daily (EU Official Journal supplement)
why_relevant: Publishes EU-funded and EU-member-state procurement including framework agreements delivering IT, payment and banking-adjacent equipment into Ukraine (e.g. Danish MFA / EU Anti-Corruption Initiative IT framework). Award notices name winning vendors and contract values for Ukraine-directed supply.

source_name: EBRD Client e-Procurement Portal (ECEPP) — Ukraine notices
why_relevant: EBRD is a major financier of Ukrainian banks and financial infrastructure; ECEPP carries procurement, prequalification and contract-award notices for EBRD-financed Ukrainian projects, including advisory and systems work touching payments and procurement reform.

source_name: UNDP Ukraine procurement notices + UNGM
why_relevant: Donor-funded procurement channel for Ukraine covering IT/e-services equipment and digital-government work; UNGM aggregates notices across 40+ UN agencies. Relevant where donor projects buy payment/e-service infrastructure or fund digital-payment programmes.

source_name: Opendatabot — tenders by company (registry + procurement mashup)
why_relevant: Joins Prozorro tender history to the company registry by EDRPOU, giving quick vendor/buyer dossiers (e.g. Ukreximbank's tender list). Efficient for building the ATM/POS/CIT supplier map and checking corporate links.

source_name: Accredited Prozorro e-marketplaces (SmartTender, Zakupki.prom.ua, DZO/IZI.TRADE, E-Tender, Playtender)
why_relevant: Accredited platforms mirror the central database and add their own search, alerting and — importantly — COMMERCIAL (non-state) tender sections where private banks and retailers buy terminals, kiosks and CIT services that never appear in state Prozorro. Also the practical route to per-buyer EDRPOU pages.

source_name: State Audit Service of Ukraine (ДАСУ) procurement monitoring conclusions
why_relevant: ДАСУ monitoring conclusions (висновки про результати моніторингу), published against individual Prozorro procedures, dissect technical requirements and award decisions. For ATM/terminal/CIT tenders they can reveal specification tailoring, incumbent advantage and real contract economics.

source_name: Radnuk / Konsaltua — public procurement practitioner press
why_relevant: Practitioner journals explaining procurement rules, payment/delivery clause drafting and weekly ДАСУ monitoring digests, with named-buyer authorship (including the NBU). Useful for interpreting contract terms and for spotting recurring buyers and disputes to follow up.

source_name: ПриватБанк — Річний (інтегрований) звіт
why_relevant: Ukraine's largest issuer/acquirer publishes an integrated annual report containing card counts, ATM estate, POS/merchant terminal counts, Privat24 users and acquiring turnover — the single richest bank-level payments dataset in Ukraine.

source_name: ПриватБанк — Фінансова звітність (розділ сайту)
why_relevant: Hub page for IFRS annual and interim financial statements; notes to accounts carry fee-and-commission income splits that proxy card/acquiring activity.

source_name: ПриватБанк — Статистична звітність за нормативними актами НБУ
why_relevant: Bank-published statistical reporting mandated by NBU regulation; a structured, recurring numeric disclosure distinct from the narrative annual report.

source_name: Ощадбанк — Новини / прес-центр
why_relevant: State savings bank with the largest branch footprint; press releases announce ATM/self-service estate modernisation, card issuance milestones and quarterly results ahead of formal reports.

source_name: Ощадбанк — офіційний сайт (звітність / про банк)
why_relevant: Root for Oschadbank's IFRS statements, management reports and network figures (branches, ATMs, payment terminals).

source_name: Міністерство фінансів України — звіти по державних банках
why_relevant: The state shareholder publishes standardised portfolio/performance decks for PrivatBank, Oschadbank, Ukrgasbank and Sense Bank — comparable cross-bank numbers not present in individual bank PR.

source_name: АТ «Універсал Банк» (monobank) — Новини
why_relevant: monobank is Ukraine's largest neobank-by-cards; the bank publishes client-count milestones, cards issued, and annual 'підсумки року' posts with card turnover — data available nowhere else.

source_name: АТ «Універсал Банк» — Фінансова звітність
why_relevant: IFRS statements for the legal entity behind monobank; commission income notes are the auditable counterpart to the bank's PR card statistics.

source_name: ПУМБ — Річні звіти / показники діяльності
why_relevant: Largest private domestic bank; the about.pumb.ua finance section splits annual reports, financial results and operating KPIs (clients, cards, network) into separate structured pages.

source_name: Райффайзен Банк (Україна) — Звіти банку / фінансова звітність МСФЗ
why_relevant: Systemically important foreign-owned bank; IFRS statements plus legacy full annual reports (e.g. ar2018) that historically carried card and terminal network figures.

source_name: Укргазбанк — Фінансова звітність / аудиторські звіти
why_relevant: State-owned bank publishing an IFRS archive back to 2017 with management reports that describe network and digital-channel development.

source_name: UKRSIBBANK (BNP Paribas Group) — Фінансова звітність та публічна інформація
why_relevant: Top-5 bank; publishes consolidated IFRS annual and interim statements plus an 'інформація до оприлюднення' page covering mandated disclosures.

source_name: OTP Bank Україна — Звітність банку / річні звіти
why_relevant: Mid-tier foreign-owned bank publishing annual reports and issuer reporting; Ukrainian-language mirror exists at otpbank.com.ua. Group-level OTP reporting adds a cross-check on Ukrainian card volumes.
